list.name: session_id
list.label: Session
list.query: SELECT session_id || ' (' || firmware_version || ' @ ' || started_at::date || ')' AS __text, session_id AS __value FROM sessions ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 100

targets.rawSql: SELECT firmware_version || ' | reset: ' || COALESCE(reset_reason,'?') || ' | telemetry: ' || telemetry_enabled AS value FROM sessions WHERE session_id = '$session_id'
SELECT device_ts_ms, server_ts, event_type, payload FROM events WHERE session_id = '$session_id' ORDER BY device_ts_ms
